shipped_rows.title_o: The Impact of Out-of-School Factors on Motivation to Learn English: Self-discrepancies, Beliefs, and Experiences of Self-authenticity

blind_target.evidence_quote: Results replicated those of Henry and Cliffordson (2017) for initial hypotheses related to motivational selves; current and ideal selves were statistically significant predictors of effort, in line with prior studies in the Chinese context.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Results replicated those of Henry and Cliffordson (2017) for initial hypotheses related to motivational selves; current and ideal selves were statistically significant predictors of effort, in line with prior studies in the Chinese context. However, results among this sample supported discrete constructs for ideal L2 and current L2 self and provide evidence of a separable sub-component of self-authenticity, digital self-authenticity.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Initial hypotheses replicated but the abstract frames construct results as contrasting with them. Publisher conclusion preview also explicitly refers to discrepancies with Henry and Cliffordson. Full results unavailable; mixed is uncertain.
